zh: 普渡大学（Purdue University）成立于1869年，位于美国印第安纳州西拉法叶市，是世界顶尖的公立研究型大学。学校在工程、农业科学、自然科学、商学、社会科学等领域享有盛誉，其学术研究水平位居世界前列。普渡大学以其优秀的教学质量和创新的研究成果，培养了大量工程技术领域的杰出人才。
en: Purdue University, founded in 1869, is a world-leading public research university in West Lafayette, Indiana. It excels in engineering, agricultural science, natural sciences, business, social sciences, and more, with world-leading academic research. Known for its excellent teaching quality and innovative research, Purdue University has produced numerous talents in engineering and technology.
